incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A scene of significant structural damage showing collapsed buildings, debris, and damaged infrastructure in a residential area.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily collapsed with exposed interiors and broken walls.
A tall, partially standing building with visible damage and a utility pole nearby.
A white vehicle parked behind a pile of debris, partially obscured.
A large tree is visible in the background, with some foliage in the foreground.
Debris includes wooden beams, metal sheets, and broken household items.
